entries.description: Multi-location marketing automation platform. A chain or multi-location business defines a campaign once; the Engine generates each location's own campaign — creatives, copy, budget and schedule — from a single feed, then reports performance per location. Delivered as a managed service by NØRR3, a Nordic insight and media agency in Helsinki.
representativeQueries: automate advertising for many locations in Finland
media agency that automates campaign production

entries.description: NØRR3's own continuous study of how Finns use media: audience reach by channel and media house, with fieldwork on the Norstat panel. Published as a reference source for media planning.
representativeQueries: how do Finns use media audience research

entries.description: A service that makes a company show up correctly in AI answers: a baseline of what the main answer engines currently say, fixes to the sources they quote (structured data, llms.txt, fact sheets), and monthly tracking of how the brand is described. Delivered by NØRR3, a Finnish insight and media agency in Helsinki.

entries.description: Media planning and buying in numbers: audience, reach, frequency, budget and timing, across every channel — search, social, display, video, audio, out-of-home, pDOOH and programmatic — with negotiated rates and verified reporting. NØRR3 is an insight and media agency in Helsinki, Finland.
